title: Martial Arts Software With a Website Included (2026)
description: Which martial arts software includes a website: Gymdesk included, MatPilot +$25/mo, Zen Planner $99/mo, Dojo Champ $199/mo, PushPress Grow $329/mo, Kicksite.
h1: Martial arts software with a website included
body:
Most martial arts schools need two things online: a website that shows the schedule and prices, and a way for visitors to book a trial or buy a membership. Some school software includes the website, some sells it as a monthly add-on, and some only gives you sign-up forms to embed on a site you build yourself. This page compares what each vendor publishes.

We checked each vendor's own pricing and website pages on November 17, 2026. We haven't used these website services ourselves and we don't publish ratings. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

What a school with about 40 students would pay for software plus a website

Using only the published prices above (before card processing fees):

  • Gymdesk: $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments or $100/mo with your own processor, website included. The lowest published total we found. {{aff:gymdesk|See Gymdesk pricing}}
  • MatPilot Pro + website: $79 + $25 = $104/mo, plus the 0.49% platform fee and Stripe's fee. Website setup is quoted by scope, with up to $500 waived on Pro. {{aff:matpilot|See MatPilot pricing}}
  • Zen Planner Essentials: $198/mo (Studio $99 + Website $99) at the entry active-member tier. {{aff:zenplanner|See Zen Planner pricing}}
  • Dojo Champ + School Website: $199 + $199 = $398/mo, unlimited students.
  • PushPress Free + Grow: $0 + $329 = $329/mo, but the Free plan's card rate is 4.99% + $0.30. PushPress doesn't say on the pricing page whether Grow needs a paid Core plan, so ask.
  • Wodify Ultimate: $499/mo list ($399/mo if the demo offer applies).
  • Kicksite: $49-$99/mo for the software; the website price is unknown, so get a quote.

Card processing usually costs more than the software itself. See martial arts billing software for each vendor's processing rates, and martial arts software pricing for software prices by student count.

Included website vs. your own site

  • Included or add-on website: the schedule, prices and trial booking stay in sync with your software automatically (Gymdesk, Zen Planner, MatPilot and Dojo Champ all say this). The catch: if you switch software later, you may need a new website too. None of these vendors publish what happens to your site or domain if you cancel, so ask before you sign up.
  • Your own site (WordPress, Squarespace, Wix) plus embedded forms: Gymdesk says all its online features (schedule, lead forms, sign-up form, member portal) work on an existing site. Spark connects with WordPress, and Martialytics offers One Touch Sign Ups. You keep the site if you switch software, but you pay the site builder separately and maintain it yourself.

Questions to ask before paying for a school website

  • Who owns the domain and the site content if I cancel?
  • Is there a setup fee? (MatPilot quotes setup by scope; the others don't publish one.)
  • Can I edit pages myself, or do I request changes?
  • Are trial bookings and sign-ups saved straight into my student list?
  • Does the site have a page for each program (kids, adults, BJJ, kickboxing) for local search?

faq: Which martial arts software includes a website for free?

Gymdesk includes a responsive gym website on every plan, from $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments for up to 50 active members (gymdesk.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-17). Wodify includes a custom website only in its Ultimate plan ($499/mo list).
How much does Zen Planner charge for a website?

Zen Planner lists its Website add-on at $99/mo. The Essentials package (Studio plus website) is $198/mo and Ultimate (adds Engage marketing) is $348/mo at the entry tier (zenplanner.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-17).
Does Kicksite build websites for martial arts schools?

Yes. Kicksite offers Basic (1-3 pages), Advanced, Premium and Multi-Location websites for its software customers, but it doesn't publish website prices (kicksite.com/martial-arts-websites, checked 2026-11-17).
Not in its Core plans. PushPress lists websites as part of PushPress Grow at $329/mo, alongside its CRM and automated email and SMS (pushpress.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-17).
Can I keep my existing website?

Yes, with most tools. Gymdesk says its schedule, lead forms, sign-up form and member portal work on an existing site, Spark connects with WordPress websites, and Martialytics offers One Touch Sign Ups for your own website.
